basic_details.job_title: NHM Theni Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 33 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Theni District Health Society, National Health Mission - TN (NHM - TN), has invited applications for 33 Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurse posts on contract basis/purely temporary in nature, against vacancies in institutions under the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services and the Directorate of Medical Education & Research. Applications go by post to the District Health Office, Theni, and must reach on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM.

qualification.details: Qualification: GNM/B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College, recognised by the Indian Nursing Council. Registration: Valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council. Age: Upto 50 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no relaxation. Nature of engagement: contract basis/purely temporary in nature. Posting: against vacancies available in institutions under the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services and the Directorate of Medical Education & Research in the district. | Candidates should check the official notification and the district-wise vacancy details for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: About NHM Theni
content_sections.text: Theni District Health Society works under the National Health Mission - TN (NHM - TN) and the Health and Family Welfare Department in Theni. The notice is signed by the Executive Secretary/District Health Officer and the Chairman/District Collector of the District Health Society, Theni.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the filled application with photocopies of the relevant documents to the address below. The notice says the applications should reach this address on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM. The District Health Officer/The Executive Secretary, District Health Office, Government Master Plan Complex, Theni District-625 531. The application form and the district-wise vacancy details can be downloaded from the NHM-TN website ( https://theni.nic.in ). The notice does not mention the postal mode, an envelope superscription or an email address.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: GNM/B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College, recognised by the Indian Nursing Council. Registration: Valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council. Age: Upto 50 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no relaxation. Nature of engagement: contract basis/purely temporary in nature. Posting: against vacancies available in institutions under the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services and the Directorate of Medical Education & Research in the district. Candidates should check the official notification and the district-wise vacancy details for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Photocopies of the relevant documents, along with the filled application.
